svg.title: The re-estimation does not resolve causality
svg.desc: Inconclusive post-pilot re-estimation of two primary outcomes. Persistent non-enrolment is estimated at 0.63 percentage points, with a CI from minus 0.77 to 2.03; the different sample that includes receiver schools gives 0.71, from minus 0.69 to 2.12. Progression failure or grade lag is estimated at 5.29 points, from 2.08 to 8.51; the different receiver-school sample gives 5.09, from 1.94 to 8.23. Missing-data bounds span minus 1.15 to 10.98 points. These are not confirmed causal effects.
